item.title: Tanzanian Student Dies In UP Road Accident During Weekend Trip To Uttarakhand
item.description: A 20-year-old Tanzanian student studying in Greater Noida died after his motorcycle hit a divider in Uttar Pradesh’s Saharanpur district while travelling with friends for a weekend outing. A 20-year-old Tanzanian national pursuing higher education in Greater Noida lost his life in a road accident in Uttar Pradesh’s Saharanpur district while heading out on a weekend trip with friends.

item.title: Indian Cannes favourite continues to await domestic release despite global acclaim

item.title: Budget 2026-27 hikes Govt capex to Rs 12.2 lakh crore in big push to infra
item.description: New Delhi: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Sunday announced a capital expenditure of Rs 12.2 lakh crore in the Budget for 2026-27, to boost big-ticket infrastructure projects for growth and jobs in the economy. Presenting the Budget, the Finance Minister said that an Infrastructure Risk Development Fund would be set up to accelerate the development of big projects. item.title: Shahid Kapoor says Leonardo DiCaprio’s advice reshaped how he chooses roles
item.description: The actor also spoke about how this mindset has reflected in his forthcoming film O’ Romeo, directed by Vishal Bhardwaj. Shahid, who has worked with Bhardwaj on multiple occasions, said that the filmmaker’s projects often present a creative journey that demands actors to find new ways of interpreting their parts.

item.title: The power of iconography: Encoding memory across time
item.description: Every generation leaves behind images that shape memory. From temples and portraits to symbols layered with meaning, visuals were once deliberate acts of remembrance. Today, selfies, filters, and cloud albums are our icons—raising the question: what story will they tell the future?

item.title: MP: 13-yr-old hosteller gives birth; accused held
item.description: Bhopal/Balaghat: A 13-year-old girl residing at the Kasturba Gandhi Balika Hostel in Parsamau village, Baihar development block, Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, gave birth to a baby girl at the district hospital’s maternity ward this week.The case has raised serious concerns about lapses in safety, health monitoring, and supervision at residential hostels intended to support girls from rural and tribal areas. item.title: Karan Johar and Aditya Roy Kapur reunite for spine-chilling horror thriller
item.description: According to industry sources, Johar’s banner Dharma Productions has finalised the film, with Kapur signing on to play the lead role. The actor reportedly agreed to the project soon after reading the script, which promises to be a unique and intense experience distinct from their earlier romantic drama.

item.title: Kolkata warehouse fire death toll rises to 27; many still missing
item.description: Kolkata: The death toll from the fire incident at the Anandapur warehouses, situated on the southern outskirts of Kolkata, has increased to 27, while 25 individuals remain unaccounted for, according to officials on Sunday.Police sources said the remains of two more people were recovered from the charred warehouses in Anandapur on Saturday, taking the death toll to 27. item.title: The poet of brevity and depth
item.description: In the quiet hills of Shimla, Kanwar Dinesh Singh crafts poetry that whispers rather than declares. With more than two decades of writing across English and Hindi, he has mastered the art of saying more with less. His verses turn silence into resonance, proving that brevity can hold profound depth
